title: Life expectancy for local areas in England, Northern Ireland and Wales
description: Period life expectancy at each age by sex and local area, from 2001 to 2003 through 2020 to 2022, with healthy life expectancy for the United Kingdom alongside it.

files.note: The published workbook. The loader reads sheet "1" — 319,206 rows covering every period, area type and age band — and keeps life expectancy at birth for local areas in 2020 to 2022. Sheet "2" holds the same figures arranged for filtering.
Sheet 1 of the healthy life expectancy workbook, exported to CSV. The workbook itself is not held here, so this extract stands in for it until the published file is downloaded.
